newsitem.title: USA: Oxford Health to unveil new care plan - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Oxford Health to unveil new care plan - WSJ.

text.p: Oxford Health Plans Inc will unveil a strategy on Tuesday to coordinate care for patients with chronic or expensive medical problems through specialists instead of primary care doctors, the Wall Street Journal said.

The plan, which would return control over costly medical decisions to specialist doctors, departs from the typical health maintenance organization procedure of requiring primary care doctors to approve their patient's specialty care, the paper said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
